meaning.en: (rail transport) Alternative spelling of four foot.
meaning.vi: (phương tiện giao thông đường sắt) Cách viết khác của bốn foot.
(cuộn tròn) Cách viết khác của 4 foot.

meaning.en: (rail transport, colloquial) The space between the rails on a standard gauge railway line.
meaning.vi: (giao thông đường sắt, thông tục) Khoảng cách giữa các đường ray trên tuyến đường sắt khổ tiêu chuẩn.

sentences.en: A sanded piece of four-foot by eight-foot plywood that's three-quarter inches thick can make a serviceable table.

sentences.en: The plywood should initially be cut in half so there are two pieces that measure four by four foot square.

sentences.en: The third piece should be the other four foot length which is placed parallel from the first four foot length then the final piece drilled into place in the remaining spot.
